claims.claim: PromptArena is for testing LLM applications
npx @altairalabs/promptarena run -c config.arena.yaml runs the npm package
The run subcommand accepts -c / --config for the config file
npm install -g @altairalabs/promptarena installs a global package of that name
npm install --save-dev @altairalabs/promptarena adds a dev dependency of that name
The npm install requires no Go toolchain
The npm package works with npm, yarn and pnpm
The npm install detects the platform automatically
promptarena run -c ./tests/config.arena.yaml is a valid package.json script invocation
The devDependency version range ^0.0.1 resolves to an existing npm version
PromptKit is distributed as a cask from the AltairaLabs tap
The promptkit cask includes both PromptArena and packc
brew install altairalabs/tap/promptarena installs the tool
promptarena --version prints the version
brew tap altairalabs/tap taps the AltairaLabs tap
brew install --cask promptkit installs the cask named promptkit
The Go install needs a C compiler and platform audio headers because the audio sink uses cgo
libasound2-dev is the audio header package on Debian/Ubuntu for this build
go install github.com/AltairaLabs/promptarena/v2/arena/cmd/promptarena@latest installs the binary
go install places the binary in $GOPATH/bin
The PromptKit Releases page is at github.com/altairalabs/promptkit/releases
The release download URL is github.com/AltairaLabs/promptarena/v2/releases/latest/download/promptarena-darwin-amd64
Release binaries are named promptarena-<os>-<arch>, e.g. promptarena-darwin-amd64
The binary is installed to /usr/local/bin/promptarena in the example
git clone https://github.com/AltairaLabs/promptarena.git clones the repository
go install ./arena/cmd/promptarena installs to $GOBIN or $GOPATH/bin
promptarena --help displays command usage and available commands
promptarena completion bash is a valid subcommand
promptarena completion zsh is a valid subcommand
promptarena completion fish is a valid subcommand
The completion file path ~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions/promptarena is the usual bash-completion location
Shell completions have their own page at /arena/how-to/setup/shell-completions/
promptarena init my-llm-tests creates a project in the named directory with guided setup
promptarena init accepts --quick and --provider flags
mock is a valid value for the --provider flag
--quick mode uses defaults without prompts
promptarena run with no -c flag runs the config in the current directory
init creates config.arena.yaml
init creates a providers/ directory
init creates a scenarios/ directory
init creates a prompts/ directory
init creates a .env file
init creates a README with next steps
apiVersion value promptkit.altairalabs.ai/v1alpha1 is the Arena config API version
kind: Arena is a valid config kind
metadata.name is a config field
spec is the top-level config object with prompts, providers and scenarios
spec.prompts is a list whose items take a path field
spec.providers is a list whose items take a path field
spec.scenarios is a list whose items take a path field
The link /arena/how-to/scenarios/write-scenarios/ resolves to an existing page
The link /arena/how-to/providers/configure-providers/ resolves to an existing page
The link /arena/tutorials/01-first-test/ resolves to an existing page
After go install the promptarena binary lands in $(go env GOPATH)/bin
Downloaded binaries are named promptarena-* so chmod +x promptarena-* matches them
Homebrew install script URL raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh is the official installer
